ios.desc:
Reading and exploring source code should be enjoyable and not limited to your desktop. NapCat is a GitHub client that lets you download your most-used or favorite projects for offline reading and coding on the go.

Features:
• Universal: one app for all your devices
• Fully offline Git client
• Powerful code editor
• Private Coding Agent Built-In (*)
• Comfortable offline reading with beautiful syntax highlighting
• Quick access to starred repositories
• Support for 90+ languages and 30 themes, so you can read comfortably in bright sunlight or late at night (**)

What users say:

"Oh @napcatapp, you're the best discovery I've made all month." -- @davidlesches
"The best code reader ever for iOS: NapCat - A GitHub Client" -- @elia
"If you're in the market for a free iPhone github code reader, I totally recommend NapCat" — @drewbiewubie
"NapCat on iPad is great when you want to offline study something cool on github" — @siuying

-----

• Full version: access to all themes
• Full version: unlimited offline code storage
• Full version: access to private repositories

-----

* Agent run locally, only context is sent to LLM
** Access to all themes is available with the Full Version upgrade

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula
